mechanism: Begin in a visually suppressed world, bind one short word or phrase to a physical obstacle in the subject's route, and require the subject's forward action to break that obstacle rather than merely passing it. Each break restores a visible part of the world; finish with one original concise statement that names the achieved state, not the source slogan.

invariants.rule: Begin with one visibly suppressed environmental state.
invariants.purpose: Creates a measurable baseline for recovery.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a baseline, color restoration has no consequence.

invariants.rule: Turn a short readable word into a real obstacle on the route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Floating captions do not participate in causality.

invariants.rule: Require forward subject action to break each obstacle.
invariants.ablation_failure: Passive explosions detach the change from the protagonist.

invariants.rule: Make each break restore a visible part of the environment.
invariants.ablation_failure: If nothing changes, repeated breaks feel interchangeable.

invariants.rule: End with one original concise statement describing the achieved state.
invariants.purpose: Provides a readable payoff without copying a slogan.
invariants.ablation_failure: A long motivational paragraph overwhelms the visual result.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: BREAK THE STATIC / RUN YOUR DAY
